items.problem: Migrated WinUI 3 package fails registration with 0x80080204 because the manifest kept UWP out-of-process windows.backgroundTasks Extensions (EntryPoint without ActivatableClassId). Build is green, app never launches, score 0.
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_launch_status (0x80080204 at manifest line 37); generated Package.appxmanifest lines 49-61 hold two <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks" EntryPoint=...> elements.
items.root_cause: Skill covered only the code-side background-task API swap; no guidance or tooling check for the invalid manifest Extension. The build passes and the Step 7 smoke launch downgrades a registration failure (no AUMID/PID) to WARN, so nothing flagged it.
items.change: Added a static manifest check to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 section 5b that FAILs when a <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks" ... EntryPoint=...> remains, printing the 0x80080204 root cause and the remove-and-migrate fix. Updated the section comment (three->four checks) and the PASS message.
items.expected_effect: Validator FAILs before the agent declares done, forcing removal of the extension; app registers and launches on re-run.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 prints '[FAIL] Package.appxmanifest declares a UWP out-of-process background task' until the extension is removed; once removed, package registration no longer errors 0x80080204 and the smoke launch reaches 'running'.

items.problem: Same root cause — the prose gave the agent no signal to touch the manifest.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Background Tasks section covered only IBackgroundTask->BackgroundTaskBuilder; Manifest checklist listed only TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust.
items.change: Expanded the Background Tasks section with the exact <Extension> to delete and the 0x80080204 explanation, and added item 5 to the Manifest migration checklist instructing removal of the windows.backgroundTasks Extension. Prose backs the Tier 1 check for agents that read docs first.
items.expected_effect: Agent removes the extension during the manifest merge, before validation.
items.falsifiable_check: Migrated Package.appxmanifest contains no <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> and the app launches.
